text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Arima Kinen?! I wanna go watch it! 
Turbo wants to go see it!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, take me to the racetrack! Take 
me, pleeease~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Twin Turbo's persistent begging, I 
decided we would watch this year's Arima 
Kinen in person.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"—The 'Arima Kinen'. The famed GⅠ race 
that crowns the end of the year. On the 
day of that race—"

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Somehow managed to qualify! Now 
that I'm in... I'll fight for every single 
spot I can get!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature! Give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From her generation, Nice Nature is in the 
lineup. And the overwhelming favorite this 
year is considered to be—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It is such a pity that Teio-san is absent 
from this grand showdown. And yet...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Even if I had made it in time for the 
Kikuka Sho, I might have passed on this 
race regardless.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The showdown—will be next spring. Which is 
precisely why I cannot afford any slip-ups 
here.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Mejiro McQueen. A powerhouse stayer from 
the prestigious Mejiro family who 
conquered the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Based on track records, Mejiro McQueen's 
victory was practically a sure thing. Or 
so everyone thought...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
What a shocker, McQueen! She finishes in 
second place in a stunning upset!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
And in third place is the newcomer, Nice 
Nature!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: Nature, you did it! You worked so hard!

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Still, Trainer, McQueen lost. The winner 
was...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo is shocked by the unexpected 
dark horse's victory. Right beside her...

text_block_list.name: Shaggy-Haired Man
text_block_list.text: WHAT IN THE WOOOOOORLD IS THIIIIIS!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A handsome guy with messy, curly hair was 
venting his frustration after losing his 
bet.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*... I lost... What an absolute 
blunder for someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's true they were completely under the 
radar... However, having worldly thoughts 
might have tripped me up as well.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
3rd place... I gave it my all, but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many times I run, it feels 
like I can't turn the tables... So this is 
Mejiro McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Though it was a major upset, Mejiro 
McQueen truly proved herself a champion. 
Even in defeat, she left a lasting 
impression of sheer strength.

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Fufun, Trainer! Teio is Turbo's number one 
rival, buuuut...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text: "In this race, I've found a new rival!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of the fearless Twin Turbo. 
Even against the strongest active stayer, 
she didn't flinch in the slightest...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
Nope~. The rival that Turbo's got her eyes 
on is...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
The Umamusume who won 1st place today! 
She's pretty good. To blow everyone away 
like that.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It wasn't Mejiro McQueen. The one 
designated as a rival was the dark-horse 
winner...

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
"She really stood out, huh? Well, Turbo 
won't lose when it comes to surprising 
people!"

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't run today, but Turbo's 
definitely running in next year's Arima 
Kinen! And then—

text_block_list.name: Twin Turbo
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna put on an incredible race. I'm 
gonna shock everyone even more than this 
year!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Twin Turbo burns with rivalry toward an 
unexpected Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The unexpected result, far from 
discouraging her, only fueled the fire in 
Twin Turbo's heart.
